solutionCodeJson.code:
# Anycast 1 — One address, two cities — answer key

1. The laptop and the server ask the same address and get different machines. What decided?Laptop và máy chủ hỏi cùng một địa chỉ mà gặp hai máy khác nhau. Cái gì quyết định?
   Answer: d) Routing: each router sends packets to the nearest announcement of 198.19.1.0/24
   Anycast is plain routing. The ISP router's best path is AS64530 directly (pop1); the DC router's best path is pop2. Nothing in DNS or in the client is involved.VI: Anycast chỉ là định tuyến bình thường. Đường tốt nhất của router nhà mạng là AS64530 trực tiếp (pop1); của router DC là pop2. DNS hay client không dính dáng gì.

2. Why is the path "64530" chosen over "64510 64530" on the ISP router?Vì sao đường "64530" được chọn thay cho "64510 64530" trên router nhà mạng?
   Answer: a) Shorter AS path: one network instead of two
   "best (AS Path)" — FRR even prints the reason. The second path goes through the datacenter's AS64510 first.VI: "best (AS Path)" — FRR in luôn lý do. Đường thứ hai đi qua AS64510 của datacenter trước.

3. pop1 withdrew at 16:22:56; the next second pop2 answered. What did clients have to change?pop1 rút lúc 16:22:56; giây sau pop2 trả lời. Client phải đổi gì?
   Answer: b) Nothing: same address, same config; the routers switched paths
   This is why root servers and public resolvers are anycast: failover in about a second, invisible to clients. Long TCP connections can break if a route change moves them mid-way (RFC 4786); DNS over UDP does not care.VI: Đó là lý do máy chủ gốc và resolver công cộng dùng anycast: chuyển dự phòng trong khoảng một giây, client không hề hay biết. Kết nối TCP dài có thể đứt nếu đổi tuyến giữa chừng (RFC 4786); DNS trên UDP thì không sao.

4. How does "dig @198.19.1.1 id.server CH TXT" help when debugging?"dig @198.19.1.1 id.server CH TXT" giúp gì khi gỡ lỗi?
   Answer: d) It tells you which instance of an anycast service you are reaching
   Same trick as the root servers in lesson 3.1. Your view of an anycast service depends on where you stand — always note which instance answered.VI: Cùng mẹo với máy chủ gốc ở bài 3.1. Thứ bạn thấy của một dịch vụ anycast tuỳ vào chỗ bạn đứng — luôn ghi lại bản nào đã trả lời.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml:
Answer key / Đáp án

  1. d) Routing: each router sends packets to the nearest announcement of 198.19.1.0/24

    Anycast is plain routing. The ISP router's best path is AS64530 directly (pop1); the DC router's best path is pop2. Nothing in DNS or in the client is involved.

    VI: Anycast chỉ là định tuyến bình thường. Đường tốt nhất của router nhà mạng là AS64530 trực tiếp (pop1); của router DC là pop2. DNS hay client không dính dáng gì.

  2. a) Shorter AS path: one network instead of two

    "best (AS Path)" — FRR even prints the reason. The second path goes through the datacenter's AS64510 first.

    VI: "best (AS Path)" — FRR in luôn lý do. Đường thứ hai đi qua AS64510 của datacenter trước.

  3. b) Nothing: same address, same config; the routers switched paths

    This is why root servers and public resolvers are anycast: failover in about a second, invisible to clients. Long TCP connections can break if a route change moves them mid-way (RFC 4786); DNS over UDP does not care.

    VI: Đó là lý do máy chủ gốc và resolver công cộng dùng anycast: chuyển dự phòng trong khoảng một giây, client không hề hay biết. Kết nối TCP dài có thể đứt nếu đổi tuyến giữa chừng (RFC 4786); DNS trên UDP thì không sao.

  4. d) It tells you which instance of an anycast service you are reaching

    Same trick as the root servers in lesson 3.1. Your view of an anycast service depends on where you stand — always note which instance answered.

    VI: Cùng mẹo với máy chủ gốc ở bài 3.1. Thứ bạn thấy của một dịch vụ anycast tuỳ vào chỗ bạn đứng — luôn ghi lại bản nào đã trả lời.

static.labflow.test is a CNAME to labflow.cdn.test; the CDN's name server ns1.cdn.test chooses the answer with BIND views (lab/moi-truong/dns/named-cdn.conf):

acl vn { 192.0.2.1; 192.0.2.30; 198.51.100.0/24; 100.64.0.0/24; };
view "vn" { match-clients { vn; }; zone "cdn.test" { type primary; file "/lab/k/moi-truong/dns/vung/cdn.test.zone"; }; };

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Anycast 2 — GeoDNS: who gets which edge? — answer key

1. Fill one row per situationĐiền mỗi tình huống một hàng
   - r1.p: not used (ISP resolver)
   - r1.r: 192.0.2.1
   - r1.a: 203.0.113.10
   - r1.e: Hanoi edge
   - r2.p: pop1 Hanoi
   - r2.r: 192.0.2.30
   - r2.a: 203.0.113.10
   - r2.e: Hanoi edge
   - r3.p: pop2 Singapore
   - r3.r: 198.19.255.2
   - r3.a: 203.0.113.11
   - r3.e: Singapore edge
   - r4.p: pop2 Singapore
   - r4.r: 198.19.255.2
   - r4.a: 203.0.113.11
   - r4.e: Singapore edge
   The CDN never sees the laptop: it sees the resolver that asks on its behalf — 192.0.2.1 is the outside address of the ISP resolver, 192.0.2.30 is pop1, 198.19.255.2 is pop2 (all in named-cdn.conf). The last row is the trap: the user did not move, but their resolver did, so a Vietnamese user is sent to Singapore. exercises.problemHtml:
Read FRR's show ip bgp <prefix> output, real from the ISP router (lab/out/c34-bgp):

BGP routing table entry for 198.19.1.0/24, version 2
Paths: (2 available, best #1, table default)
  Advertised to peers:
  192.0.2.3 192.0.2.30 192.0.2.66
  64530
    192.0.2.30 from 192.0.2.30 (192.0.2.30)
      Origin IGP, metric 0, valid, external, best (AS Path)
      Last update: Sun Nov  1 17:16:01 2026
  64510 64530
    192.0.2.3 from 192.0.2.3 (192.0.2.3)
      Origin IGP, valid, external
      Last update: Sun Nov  1 17:16:01 2026

Write bgpBest(text) returning { prefix, paths, chosen }:

  • prefix — from the first line ("BGP routing table entry for …");
  • a path starts with a line of exactly two spaces + the AS numbers (or Local ⇒ empty array); the next line, four spaces + the next hop + " from …", gives nextHop; the line after it contains best as a separate word when FRR selected it. Each path: { asPath: [numbers], nextHop, best };
  • chosen — the index you would select: the shortest AS path; a tie goes to the numerically lowest next-hop address (a simplification of BGP's later tie-breakers). On real outputs it must agree with FRR's best.

Careful: the "Advertised to peers:" line also starts with two spaces, but is not an AS path. Hidden cases: constructed entries — three paths where the best is the second, and the table right after pop1 withdrew (one path left).

Requirements

  • Return the value; do not print it.
  • Do not modify the arguments.

exercises.title: Anycast 6 — Write geoAnswer(): how a GeoDNS server chooses
exercises.problemHtml:
Reproduce the CDN's BIND views (lab/moi-truong/dns/named-cdn.conf):

acl vn { 192.0.2.1; 192.0.2.30; 198.51.100.0/24; 100.64.0.0/24; };
view "vn" { match-clients { vn; }; zone "cdn.test" { type primary; file "/lab/k/moi-truong/dns/vung/cdn.test.zone"; }; };
view "sg" { match-clients { any; }; zone "cdn.test" { type primary; file "/lab/k/moi-truong/dns/vung/cdn.test.sg.zone"; }; };

Write geoAnswer(views, resolverIp, ecs). views is an ordered array [{ name, match: [...], answer }]; each match entry is an IPv4 address (= /32), a CIDR block, or "any". Return { view, answer } of the first view with a matching entry, or { view: null, answer: null }.

The address tested is resolverIp — the GeoDNS server only sees who asks. If the optional ecs (EDNS Client Subnet, e.g. "198.51.100.0/24") is given, test the network address of that subnet instead: that is exactly what ECS changes.

Visible cases are the real resolvers of the lab: the ISP resolver's outside address 192.0.2.1, pop1 192.0.2.30, pop2 198.19.255.2. Hidden cases: pop2 forwarding the house's subnet with ECS, and a constructed three-view setup with /11 blocks and 0.0.0.0/0.

Requirements

  • Return the value; do not print it.
  • Do not modify the arguments.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A GeoDNS server is just "first matching rule wins" over the address of whoever asks. Because that address is the resolver's, users of a distant resolver get a distant edge — the Vietnam-to-Singapore case of exercise 2 — and ECS fixes it only by revealing part of the user's address to every authoritative server on the path.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: Máy chủ GeoDNS chỉ là "luật khớp đầu tiên thắng" trên địa chỉ của người hỏi.
